Author: V.G.Arun

 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr.Justice V.G.Arun
 Tuesday, the 20th day of December 2022 / 29th Agrahayana, 1944
 Wp(C) No. 11725 Of 2020
 Petitioner:
 Tom Jacob, Managing Partner,Kayyalakam Oil Company,
 Cheeranchira.P.O, Changanacherry, Kottayam-686106.
 Respondents:
 1. State Of Kerala, Represented By The Secretary To Government, Health

 And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to issue an interim order allowing the petitioner to continue the  manufacture and marketing the two brands of coconut oil namely Hrudayam  and Nalla which are already registered with Food Safety and Standards Act  as evident from Exhibit P-5 license issued, notwithstanding Exhibit P-16  order, pending decision of the above WP(C).

This petition again coming on for orders upon perusing the petition  and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and this court's order dated  13.12.2022 and upon hearing the arguments of M/S T.V.AJAYAKUMAR and RIMJU  P.H., Advocates for the petitioner, GOVERNMENT PLEADER, ADDITIONAL  DIRECTOR GENERAL OF PROSECUTION and of SRI. K.V. SOHAN, STATE ATTORNEY for  R1, R2 and R3, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Post on 22.12.2022.
Interim order is extended till then.
Sd/- V.G.ARUN, JUDGE 20-12-2022 /True Copy/
